messages:
Anika: FYI we pushed delta-merge-optimizer v0.1 as a hotpatch to 20% at 06:04 UTC to mitigate a short-request tail regression seen in last night's deploy. quick summary below.
Tom: hotpatch? what broke and why skip normal canary?
Anika: last deploy left a microbatching change that increased tail for seq<64. this hotpatch reworks delta merges to prefer append-over-rewrite for short KV segments. we fast-tracked because customer-facing p99 spiked ~2am for some tenants.
Caleb: numbers pls (before -> after)
Anika: short table (hotpatch vs immediate pre-hotfix baseline):
```
workload | p50 -> p50 | p99 -> p99 | cost/unit
short-chat (seq<64) | 33ms -> 24ms | 310ms -> 215ms | 1.00 -> 0.86
rwd-13b inference mix | 68ms -> 54ms | 520ms -> 410ms | 1.00 -> 0.90
emb-short | 28ms -> 22ms | 115ms -> 92ms | 1.00 -> 0.92
```
Sofia: huge p99 drop on short-chat, nice. any side-effects on throughput or worker health?
Anika: CPU delta +9% on patched nodes during bursts, memory steady. throughput per-GPU improved slightly because less queue churn. infra-bot healthchecks ran, no OOMs or GC spikes.
infra-bot: {"patch_id":"dmo-hot-2901","duration_min":30,"checks":{"latency":true,"errors":true,"metrics_stable":true},"events":["customer-p99-spike@02:03"]}
Tom: did any customers see increased errors during the hotpatch window?
Anika: observed two transient 502s from a tenant proxied through a regional gateway; both auto-retried successfully. no increase in client-visible error rates.
Caleb: rollback criteria for this hotpatch?
Anika: auto-rollback triggers: p99 > baseline + 50% sustained for 3m OR error-rate increase >1% for 2m. manual rollback route to delta-merge-v0 in ops playbook. also added a safety flag to mute the optimization per-tenant if needed.
Sofia: what's the plan for normal GA/rollout now that it's a hotpatch?
Anika: we will:
- keep at 20% for 6h with hourly bench snapshots,
- 20% -> 40% after 6h if green, then 40% -> 80% in 12h, then 100% in 36h.
We will convert the hotpatch into an official release branch with tests and full bench write-up. GA target: 10 days.
Tom: can you drop a 1-slide exec blurb and a short post for #release-announcements when we hit 100%? include the TL;DR and the cost delta.
Anika: TL;DR for execs: "Delta-merge optimizer hotpatch cut short-request p99 by ~31% and lowered unit cost ~14% during emergency rollout; formal release tracking and GA within 10 days."
Caleb: please also add a short snippet to the ops playbook showing how to flip the per-tenant mute flag.
Anika: config snippet for ops (ops playbook will include full commands):
```
# mute delta-merge for tenant
route:
  tenant_id: 12345
  optimizations:
    delta_merge: off
```
infra-bot: monitoring: next snapshot in 15m.
Sofia: awesome response. if all green, we'll include this in the Monday infra bulletin.
Anika: will write the bench doc and link PR: https://github.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/5048. ping this thread for urgent alerts.
